title: Paid Supply dialog floors away the original's over-capacity giveback and refund
body:
Found during the owner-requested restrictions/provenance audit after v0.8.2. Source comparison plus native production-model reproduction; no new original-game run.

[SupplyDialogModel.AdjustStaged](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/godot/UI/Dialogs/SupplyDialogModel.cs#L252) floors the upper bound at zero, then clamps the final staged amount to nonnegative. TransferStaged submits only when staged > 0. This prevents the signed over-capacity paid return that the engine already supports.

The [promoted supply-capacity report, Foreign city: paid, staged](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/supply-capacity-rounding.md) gives a different operation order: max(0, old amount ± step) FIRST, then min(stock), min(room), min(money×5). Room can be negative, making the final amount negative; Transfer returns excess supply to the city and refunds amount/5. [Purse-writes report row3](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-05-army-purse-writes-and-the-1000-cap.md) also describes this signed paid refund. This is code-derived original behavior; do not claim a fresh Windows observation.

Native synthetic reproduction at released4d70275a, shipped classical-faithful rules and production Godot-free model: LI10000 troops, army supplies206, purse100; non-hostile foreign city stock330. Dialog capacity101 means room -105. Select foreign city; AdjustStaged(+100) gives staged0, cost0, TransferStaged=null. Direct production SupplyPurchase.BuyForArmy(... request100) admits -105, leaves army supply101 and purse121. Thus this is a reachable UI/engine disagreement, not a missing engine refund formula. Probe exited0. No owner/private saves used.

Existing test The_staged_amount_never_goes_below_zero only uses positive room; its name overgeneralizes that state. Source documents claim the dialog invents no rule, but the final floor changes the signed chain.

Triage: fidelity correction needed; audit does not implement or assign a release. Preserve normal decrement-to-zero staging, paid/free distinctions, signed room ordering, conservation and existing explicit design policies. A later correction must handle the command boundary deliberately (buy currently accepts positive requests and computes negative admitted supply; do not simply send a negative request into its existing rejection). Exercise production dialog and helper together. No similar dedicated existing issue found.
